profile.headline: Software Engineer | Systems Thinker | Value Creator
profile.summary: Software engineer and consultant who builds scalable, performant, customer-centric solutions that improve user experience and business metrics. I design architectures, optimize systems, and manage full-lifecycle delivery. Committed to continuous learning and practical collaboration to solve complex challenges.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led enhancements to a custom Atlassian Confluence app, focusing on visualizing data lineage and improving system traceability through interactive tools and performance optimization.

- Integrated a flow diagram feature for visualizing systems data flows and lineage.
- Developed an interactive mapping tool linking report image regions to lineage paths.
- Refactored key components to avoid Atlassian rate limits and improve efficiency.
- Stack: React, NodeJS, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, CSS, Git, CI/CD, Bitbucket, Confluence, Jira, React Flow, React Image Crop.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Infrastructure · Software Design · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Solutions Engineering

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Focused on front-end scalability and backend flexibility, contributing to ETL capabilities and dynamic notification systems.

- Optimized front-end componentization to enhance scalability and reduce implementation time.
- Extended backend functionality to support flexible ETL data processing.
- Refactored the notifications module into a React-based dynamic template system.
- Stack: React, NodeJS, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, CSS, Git/GitHub, CI/CD, SQL Server, MongoDB, NestJS.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Infrastructure · Software Design · Solutions Engineering

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Built a secure, custom Confluence-hosted web app to support data lineage documentation and certification workflows.

- Created a web application to meet security certification standards for data lineage documentation.
- Implemented FaaS backend services for secure data access.
- Automated CI/CD workflows to streamline integration and deployment.
- Stack: React, NodeJS, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, CSS, Git, CI/CD, Bitbucket, Confluence, Jira.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Pioneered micro frontend architecture and federated module design to enable modular, scalable application development.

- Designed micro frontends for independent development and deployment.
- Engineered federated modules that function standalone or integrate with host apps.
- Built shared libraries for layouts, services, and security across modules.
- Stack: React, NodeJS, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, CSS/SASS, Git, NextJS, Nx, Docker, Vite.

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description:
At ECRI, I developed modular web applications and internal RESTful APIs to support system integration and data workflows. I played a key role in ensuring code quality and consistency across development efforts while enhancing security and deployment reliability.

- Built scalable web applications and internal APIs for enterprise integration
- Integrated Identity Server for secure authentication and authorization
- Supported CI/CD pipeline troubleshooting to streamline deployments
- Designed database components for efficient data operations
- Participated in code reviews and implementation support across teams
- Stack: .NET Core, NextJS, NodeJS, React, Fastify, JavaScript/TypeScript, C#, HTML, CSS/SASS, Git/GitLab, SQL Server, Linux, Jira, Confluence, Git, Docker, Flyway, Dapper, Kubernetes (K8s).
positions.insights: Skills: Database Design · Dependable Team Player · Integration · Front-end Development · Back-End Web Development

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led development of modular web applications and RESTful APIs, contributing to UI design, system architecture, and deployment automation. Focused on building secure, scalable, and maintainable solutions.

- Developed middleware for external service integration and data processing
- Integrated Firebase Authentication for user access control and API security
- Configured CI/CD tooling to enhance deployment workflows
- Authored system documentation and participated in code reviews
- Stack: Angular, NestJS, NodeJS, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, CSS/SASS, Git, GCP (Google Cloud), Kubernetes (K8s), Docker, Skaffold, Firebase, Bazel.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Engineered customer-facing applications for product personalization and built an admin portal for managing configurations. Led backend development and CRM integration to streamline operations.

- Developed RESTful APIs and middleware for external service integration
- Designed database schemas to support dynamic product configurations
- Built a data exchange subsystem for CRM synchronization
- Delivered scalable, user-friendly web solutions for e-commerce
- Stack: Angular, MySQL, .NET Core, RESTful APIs, C#, SQL Server, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML5, CSS, UML, Scrum, Git/GitHub, AWS (EC2/RDS), Linux, Nginx.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Contributed to full-stack development and architectural planning for enterprise systems. Focused on secure access control and evaluating new technologies for adoption.

- Developed RESTful APIs and middleware for service integration
- Designed claims-based security modules for UI and API access
- Conducted PoC research on third-party tools and libraries
- Participated in requirement analysis and code reviews

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led backend development and system integration efforts, focusing on secure authentication and deployment reliability.

- Engineered Web APIs for third-party service integration
- Configured IIS servers and CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins
- Integrated SSO using SAML2 with external Identity Providers
- Authored internal documentation and supported build troubleshooting

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer Consulting
positions.description:
Oversaw Agile development and stakeholder collaboration for scalable backend systems. Led technical research and architectural planning for cloud-based deployments.

- Managed sprint planning, task allocation, and code reviews
- Designed and extended RESTful APIs and backend services
- Resolved technical challenges through stakeholder engagement
- Conducted research to guide architectural decisions

projects.title: Earlier Career — Senior Software Engineer / Lead Roles
projects.description:
Ana‑Data Consulting Inc.

Delivered modular components, modernized product architecture, and mentored development teams.

- Led R&D efforts introducing new technologies and architectural patterns that modernized the company’s product suite.  
- Developed modular software components that reduced implementation time and improved extensibility for application extensions and services.  
- Engineered web and desktop applications while mentoring junior developers and shaping development standards, increasing team efficiency.  
- Tech stack: C#, .NET Framework, Excel VSTO, Visual Studio Tools for Office, DevExpress WPF, Prism, Unity (IoC), MVVM, MDX, XML, WCF, SQL Server, WPF.

projects.title: Golang DI (go-di) Dependency Injection library
projects.description:
The go-di project is a lightweight and flexible dependency injection library for Go. It provides a simple way to manage service lifetimes and resolve dependencies in Go applications. The library supports three instance scopes: Transient, Singleton, and Scoped.

What does go-di do?

Simplifies dependency management in Go applications.
Provides thread-safe service resolution.
Supports scoped contexts for better resource management.
Lightweight and easy to integrate.

For more details visit: https://github.com/lcrux/go-di
